title: Machines Out With a TechWorks Crew When a Renew Business Asset Buyback Run Is Settled
content:
A service crew attending the site holds machines back from a collection run on a Renew Business Asset Buyback agreement as well, because the crew has machines open on the bench while it is there. What the profile holds under Northbeam TechWorks Installation and Repair, and the visits drawn on it, settle how many.

**Where the profile holds a service agreement standing dispatched, and a visit was drawn on it within the last month**
the machines held back while a service crew is attending are the full crew figure, being 4 machines.

**Where the profile holds a service agreement standing scheduled, and no visit was drawn on it within the last month**
the machines held back while a service crew is attending are the part crew figure, being 2 machines.

**Where the profile holds neither**
no machine is held back on that account.

**Reading the two conditions together.** Each branch is a pair: a state the service agreement stands in, and what the visits drawn on it in the last month show.

| Service agreement stands | A visit drawn on it within the last month | Machines held back |
| --- | --- | --- |
| dispatched | yes | 4 |
| scheduled | no | 2 |
| neither of those two states | — | none |

A visit drawn within the last month is counted from the visits recorded against the profile's Northbeam TechWorks Installation and Repair agreements over that month; one such visit is enough for the first branch, and the second branch requires that the month carry none.
